SerpApi

Dated search visibility you can investigate.

SOfficial product ↗Open in the hierarchy →
Level 4Inspect the detail

Retrieve structured search-result data through SerpApi's supported engine endpoints. MoreSpace can build keyword monitoring, market-specific result comparisons, and content-research workspaces that keep query, location, device settings, and collection time together. Search snapshots provide evidence about the returned results under those settings; we interpret them alongside site analytics and commercial outcomes when deciding what to improve.

Useful outputs

  • Structured dated search snapshots
  • Position and result-change reports
  • Evidence for analyst-reviewed recommendations

Where we can apply it

  • Keyword set → scheduled snapshots → analyst comparison → search-improvement backlog.
  • New market query → localized results → source review → content-opportunity brief.
  • Brand query watchlist → result changes → review queue → reputation or content action.
01

Use case 1

Monitor an agreed keyword set across configured markets.

02

Use case 2

Compare returned search results for a defined query and device.

03

Use case 3

Collect research evidence for a reviewed content or search plan.

Inputs we need

  • An agreed keyword or query set
  • Market and device parameters
  • Snapshot cadence and comparison rules

Delivery sequence

  • Define the tracked queries and keep their settings consistent.
  • Collect supported result fields and preserve query context and timestamps.
  • Compare snapshots, inspect meaningful changes, and connect findings to site outcomes.

Expert review points

  • Avoid treating one result snapshot as a complete measure of demand.
  • Verify source pages and query context before recommending changes.

We confirm available integrations, plans, permissions, and data mapping before implementing these connection candidates.

  • Google BigQuery
  • n8n
  • Retool
  • Custom SEO workspaces

Signals we can make visible

  • Tracked query coverage
  • Observed organic position
  • Result-change rate
  • Search snapshot freshness

We agree the source, population, period, denominator, and decision behind each measure.
